name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]

jobs:
  gpu-diagnostic-pipes:
    name: GPU diagnostic pipe contracts (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Preserve typed device failures and bounded diagnostic records
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_gpu_backend --lib startup_diagnostics -- --test-threads=1 --color=never
      - name: Return and exit with a full unread stderr pipe
        run: python scripts/check_gpu_startup_diagnostic_pipes.py

  portable-save:
    name: Atomic portable save (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Preserve prior saves through write and publication failures
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_world --test atomic_portable_save
      - name: Keep births supported without stalling world ticks
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_world --lib task_4_3a2_tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'

  native-texture-decode:
    name: Native texture decode (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
      RUST_MIN_STACK: '33554432'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy
      - name: Install Linux controller build dependency
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libudev-dev
      - name: Decode and reject zstd KTX2 through the production Bevy image path
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --test bevy_texture_decode
      - name: Check native production targets
        run: cargo check --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --all-targets
      - name: Run exact-head speech and naming CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_conversation_lineage_ui:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run exact-head menu opening-key and modal CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::menu:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run exact-head queued-care help CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::care_dock::tests::help_feedback:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run exact-head care accessibility CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::care_dock::tests::accessible_input:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run exact-head playback focus and key-repeat CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::ux_input::tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Strict production frontend library and test Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib --tests -- -D warnings

  island-output-changes:
    name: Island output-change frontend CPU regression
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '1'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
      RUST_MIN_STACK: '33554432'
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Install Linux controller build dependency
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libudev-dev
      - name: Run island output change-tick and invalidation CPU tests
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::island::update_tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run camera clamp and change-tick CPU tests
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::island::camera_tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run camera scroll units and display-scale CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::camera_navigation::tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run selection highlight parity and neighboring pointer CPU tests
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::god_hand:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run live food projection and carried-object CPU tests
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::live_food_projection::tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run live sleep phase and lifecycle CPU tests
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::live_sleep_feedback::tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run selected-creature HUD CPU data and layout tests
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::status_hud:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run individual naming and shared speech input CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_conversation_lineage_ui:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run menu opening-key and modal CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib production_voxel_renderer::menu:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run Hearthling skin, shared-material and inherited-paw CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib hearthling -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Bound shipping Hearthling skin across authored and inherited transforms
        run: python3 scripts/test_hearthling_skin_bounds.py
      - name: Run saved-appearance identity and inheritance CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib appearance -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'
      - name: Run graphics-capture visibility and screenshot delivery CPU regressions
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features production-voxel-frontend --lib graphics_capture:: -- --test-threads=1 --color=never'

  training-continuity:
    name: Training checkpoint continuity
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy
      - name: Check training CLI
        run: cargo check --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --bin train_n2048_care
      - name: Read-only native build identity CLI
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --test native_build_info -- --test-threads=1
      - name: Strict foundation-training Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - name: Adaptive game exploration shader and host CPU contracts
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_gpu_backend --all-targets --features training-rollout
      - name: Familiar-object unresolved-gap input chain CPU regression
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib repeated_sealed_mismatch_keeps_familiar_object_gap_evidence_target_local
      - name: Foundation scenario and replay CPU tests
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_training::'
      - name: Bounded headless observation CPU tests
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib gpu_live_runtime::headless_trace::tests'
      - name: Continuous-session receipt supervisor contracts
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_run_continuous_care.py -v
      - name: Continuous-world runtime profile and store contracts
        run: |
          cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib continuous_world:: -- --test-threads=1
          cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib resident::continuous_store -- --test-threads=1
      - name: Group-50 native admission and replay CPU contracts
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_training_cycle::group::'
      - name: Residual critic batching CPU regression
        run: 'cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_training_cycle::critic_residual::'
      - name: Compile opt-in residual critic hardware fixture
        run: cargo check --locked -p alife_training --features gpu-tests --lib --tests
      - name: Compile opt-in training hardware fixtures
        run: cargo check --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training,gpu-tests --all-targets
      - name: Objective continuation CPU tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_training_cycle::founder_refresh_tests::objective_continuation
      - name: Initial actor checkpoint CPU tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_training_cycle::founder_refresh_tests::initial_actor_checkpoint
      - name: Warmup lesson corpus CPU tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_training_warmup::tests
      - name: Acquisition rehearsal CPU tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_acquisition_rehearsal::tests
      - name: Archived checkpoint inspection CPU tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_archived_success_replay::tests
      - name: Read-only inspection CLI CPU tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --bin inspect_archived_success
      - name: Exact cached replay compiler private-state and RAM admission contracts
        run: |
          cargo test --locked -p alife_training --features receipt-lineage --lib backend_handoff::tests -- --test-threads=1
          cargo test --locked -p alife_training --features receipt-lineage --lib cache_codec_tests -- --test-threads=1
          cargo test --locked -p alife_training --features receipt-lineage --lib trainer::tests -- --test-threads=1
          cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib replay_io_tests -- --test-threads=1
          cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib throughput_ -- --test-threads=1
          cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib replay_window_cache -- --test-threads=1
          cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib critic_residual::tests -- --test-threads=1

  training-output-preservation:
    name: Training output preservation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Check training CLI
        run: cargo check --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --bin train_n2048_care
      - name: Care targeting inspection CPU tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --bin train_n2048_care targeting_tests
      - name: Output ownership CPU tests
        run: cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib foundation_training_output::tests

  rust:
    name: Rust workspace validation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Source-bound evidence tests read their exact historical producer revision.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Format
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Stage timing observation admission
        run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_stage_timing_observations.py -v

      - name: Check
        id: check
        run: cargo check --locked --workspace --all-targets

      - name: Test
        run: cargo test --locked --workspace --all-targets --no-fail-fast

      - name: Clippy
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.check.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Core boundaries
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.check.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: bash scripts/check_core_boundaries.sh

          import hashlib
          import io
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import platform
          import re
          import subprocess
          import tarfile

          def command(*args):
              return subprocess.check_output(args, text=True).strip()

          revision = command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')

          rustc = command('rustc', '-vV')
          with binary.open('rb') as handle:
              digest = hashlib.file_digest(handle, 'sha256').hexdigest()
          receipt = {
              'schema': 1,
              'source_revision': revision,
              'source_tree': command('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'),
              'executable_sha256': digest,
              'executable_bytes': binary.stat().st_size,
              'additional_executables': {round_binary.name: {
                  'sha256': hashlib.file_digest(round_binary.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest(),
                  'bytes': round_binary.stat().st_size,
              }},
              'rustc': rustc,
              'target': next(line.removeprefix('host: ') for line in rustc.splitlines() if line.startswith('host: ')),
              'minimum_glibc': minimum_glibc,
              'dynamic_libraries': re.findall(r'Shared library: \[(.*?)\]', command('readelf', '-d', str(binary))),
              'build_host': {'system': platform.system(), 'machine': platform.machine(), 'libc': platform.libc_ver()},
              'features': ['cpu-training'],
              'build_profile': 'dev',
              'production_training_executed': False,
              'founder_promoted': False,
              'workflow_run': f"https://github.com/{os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']}/actions/runs/{os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']}",
          }
          artifact = Path('target/cpu-training-artifact')
          artifact.mkdir()
          receipt_bytes = (json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
          with tarfile.open(artifact / 'cpu-training.tar.gz', 'w:gz') as archive:
              archive.add(binary, arcname=binary.name)
              archive.add(round_binary, arcname=round_binary.name)
              info = tarfile.TarInfo('build-receipt.json')
              info.size = len(receipt_bytes)
              info.mode = 0o644
              archive.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(receipt_bytes))
          PY
      - name: Upload CPU executable and receipt
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cpu-training-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: target/cpu-training-artifact

# Results are posted to the PR or branch-head commit.
# Requires a connected Jules source and the JULES_API_KEY repository secret.

name: Jules review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  push:
    branches: ['codex/**']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      branch:
        description: 'Branch to review (e.g. codex/training-readiness-20261001)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write # post commit comments on the branch head
  pull-requests: write # post PR comments

concurrency:
  group: jules-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  review:
    # Pushes: only review newly created branches, not every follow-up push.
    if: github.event_name != 'push' || github.event.created == true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      # The notice gives November 11 without an exact time or timezone:
      # https://jules.google/docs/changelog/2026-10-29
      # Conservatively stop new requests at the start of that day in UTC;
      # this is our earlier cutoff, not a time specified by Google.
      - name: Check Jules retirement cutoff
        id: retirement
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/jules-creation-gate.py" <<'PYTHON'
          from datetime import datetime, timezone
          import os

          cutoff = datetime(2026, 11, 11, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
          allowed = datetime.now(timezone.utc) < cutoff
          value = str(allowed).lower()
          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
              output.write(f"creation_allowed={value}\n")
          if not allowed:
              with open(os.environ["GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"], "a") as summary:
                  summary.write(
                      "## Jules review retired: no session created\n\n"
                      "New Jules sessions are disabled by this repository's conservative "
                      f"{cutoff:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC} cutoff. No substantive code review or approval "
                      "was performed by this run.\n"
                  )
          print(value)
          PYTHON
          python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/jules-creation-gate.py"

      - name: Resolve review target
        id: target
        if: steps.retirement.outputs.creation_allowed == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PR_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
          PR_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PR_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          INPUT_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
          PUSH_REF: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          PUSH_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "pull_request" ]; then
            MODE=pr
            REF="$PR_REF"
            SHA="$PR_SHA"
            BASE="$PR_BASE"
            TITLE="PR #$PR_NUMBER review"
          else
            MODE=branch
            if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
              REF="$INPUT_BRANCH"
              git check-ref-format --branch "$REF" >/dev/null
              SHA="$(gh api "repos/$REPO/commits/$REF" -q .sha)"
            else
              REF="$PUSH_REF"
              SHA="$PUSH_SHA"
            fi
            BASE="$(gh api "repos/$REPO/commits/main" -q .sha)"
            TITLE="Branch $REF review"
          fi
          DIFF_URL="https://github.com/$REPO/compare/$BASE...$SHA.diff"
          {
            echo "mode=$MODE"
            echo "ref=$REF"
            echo "sha=$SHA"
            echo "base=$BASE"
            echo "diff_url=$DIFF_URL"
            echo "title=$TITLE"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Reviewing $MODE $REF @ $SHA"

      - name: Create Jules review session
        id: jules
        if: steps.retirement.outputs.creation_allowed == 'true'
        env:
          JULES_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.JULES_API_KEY }}
          DIFF_URL: ${{ steps.target.outputs.diff_url }}
          REF: ${{ steps.target.outputs.ref }}
          BASE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.base }}
          SHA: ${{ steps.target.outputs.sha }}
          TITLE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.title }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Target resolution may have crossed the deadline. Check before secrets/sources.
          CREATION_ALLOWED="$(python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/jules-creation-gate.py")"
          [ "$CREATION_ALLOWED" = true ] || exit 0
          if [ -z "$JULES_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo "::error::JULES_API_KEY secret is not set. Add it under Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions."
            exit 1
          fi
          SOURCE="$(curl -fsS -H "X-Goog-Api-Key: $JULES_API_KEY" \
            'https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/sources?pageSize=100' | \
            jq -r --arg repo "$REPO" \
            '.sources[] | select((.githubRepo.owner + "/" + .githubRepo.repo) == $repo) | .name' | head -n 1)"
          if [ -z "$SOURCE" ] || [ "$SOURCE" = "null" ]; then
            echo "::error::No Jules source connected for $REPO. Connect it at https://jules.google.com first."
            exit 1
          fi
          PROMPT="Review commit $SHA of branch $REF in $REPO against base commit $BASE.
          1. Fetch and check out that exact commit, then read its immutable diff:
             git fetch origin $SHA
             git checkout --detach $SHA
             curl -fsSL $DIFF_URL
          Review repository changes at those commits, not files generated by your own review tools.
          2. Review every changed hunk for:
             - correctness bugs and logic errors
             - non-exhaustive matches and unhandled enum variants
             - dead code and unused items
             - API misuse, type errors, off-by-one mistakes
             - anything that would break 'cargo check --workspace --all-targets', clippy, or the test suite
             - Rust specifics: ownership/borrow errors, missing error handling, panics on unwrap/expect in non-test code
             - life-simulation code: behavior that would break believable emergent creature behavior
               (physics/contact math, genetics, biochemistry, learning) — flag world bugs, not just test bugs
          3. Be specific: file path and line number for each finding, with a brief quote of the offending code.
          4. Skip style nitpicks unless they signal a real problem. No filler praise.
          Write concise markdown with concrete findings and their impact.
          If no actionable issue is found, say so and identify material unverified behavior.
          Review only. Do not open pull requests, push branches, or modify any code."
          # Source discovery may also have crossed the deadline; do not submit late.
          CREATION_ALLOWED="$(python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/jules-creation-gate.py")"
          [ "$CREATION_ALLOWED" = true ] || exit 0
          RESPONSE="$(curl -fsS -X POST \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -H "X-Goog-Api-Key: $JULES_API_KEY" \
            -d "$(jq -n --arg prompt "$PROMPT" --arg source "$SOURCE" \
              --arg branch "$REF" --arg title "$TITLE" \
              '{prompt: $prompt, title: $title, sourceContext: {source: $source, githubRepoContext: {startingBranch: $branch}}}')" \
            'https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/sessions')"
          SESSION_NAME="$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.name // empty')"
          SESSION_URL="$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.url // empty')"
          if [ -z "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then
            echo "::error::Failed to create Jules session: $RESPONSE"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "session_name=$SESSION_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "session_url=$SESSION_URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Created session: $SESSION_NAME ($SESSION_URL)"

      - name: Wait for review to complete
        id: wait
        if: steps.jules.outputs.session_name != ''
        env:
          JULES_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.JULES_API_KEY }}
          SESSION_NAME: ${{ steps.jules.outputs.session_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          STATE=""
          for i in $(seq 1 60); do
            STATE="$(curl -fsS -H "X-Goog-Api-Key: $JULES_API_KEY" \
              "https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/$SESSION_NAME" | jq -r '.state // empty')"
            echo "Poll $i: state=$STATE"
            case "$STATE" in
              COMPLETED|FAILED|CANCELLED) break ;;
            esac
            sleep 20
          done
          echo "final_state=$STATE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Post review comment
        if: always() && steps.retirement.outputs.creation_allowed == 'true' && steps.jules.outputs.creation_allowed != 'false'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          JULES_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.JULES_API_KEY }}
          SESSION_NAME: ${{ steps.jules.outputs.session_name }}
          SESSION_URL: ${{ steps.jules.outputs.session_url }}
          FINAL_STATE: ${{ steps.wait.outputs.final_state }}
          MODE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.mode }}
          SHA: ${{ steps.target.outputs.sha }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          REVIEW=""
          if [ "$FINAL_STATE" = "COMPLETED" ] && [ -n "$SESSION_NAME" ]; then
            PAGE_TOKEN=""
            : > /tmp/jules-activities.jsonl
            while :; do
              ACTIVITIES="$(curl -fsS -G -H "X-Goog-Api-Key: $JULES_API_KEY" \
                --data-urlencode 'pageSize=100' --data-urlencode "pageToken=$PAGE_TOKEN" \
                "https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/$SESSION_NAME/activities")"
              echo "$ACTIVITIES" | jq -c '.activities[]?' >> /tmp/jules-activities.jsonl
              PAGE_TOKEN="$(echo "$ACTIVITIES" | jq -r '.nextPageToken // empty')"
              [ -n "$PAGE_TOKEN" ] || break
            done
            REVIEW="$(jq -sr 'sort_by(.createTime) | [.[].agentMessaged.agentMessage
              | select(type == "string" and length > 0)] | last // empty' /tmp/jules-activities.jsonl)"
          fi
          {
            echo "## Jules code review (automated)"
            echo "Commit: \`$SHA\`"
            echo ""
            if [ -n "$REVIEW" ]; then
              echo "$REVIEW"
            elif [ "$FINAL_STATE" = "COMPLETED" ]; then
              echo "Jules finished the review, but the review text could not be extracted automatically."
            else
              echo "The Jules review did not complete (final state: ${FINAL_STATE:-unknown})."
            fi
            echo ""
            echo "---"
            if [ -n "$SESSION_URL" ] && [ "$SESSION_URL" != "null" ]; then
              echo "*Automated review by Jules. [View the full session]($SESSION_URL)*"
            else
              echo "*Automated review by Jules.*"
            fi
          } > /tmp/review.md
          if [ "$MODE" = "pr" ]; then
            gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" -F /tmp/review.md
          else
            gh api --method POST "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/comments" -F body=@/tmp/review.md
          fi
          echo "Review comment posted."

concurrency:

jobs:

    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: '0'
      RUST_MIN_STACK: '33554432'
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: '1'
      EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source_revision || github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      BUILD_PROFILE: ${{ inputs.profile || 'dev' }}
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    steps:
      - name: Validate exact build request
        run: |
          if ($env:EXPECTED_SOURCE -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw 'Exact lowercase source commit required' }
          if ($env:BUILD_PROFILE -notin @('dev','release')) { throw 'Unknown native build profile' }
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          shared-key: windows-foundation-native
      - name: Device-free resident loss recovery and ownership contracts
        if: ${{ !inputs.build_only }}
        run: |
          cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib resident -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Resident contracts failed' }
          cargo test --locked -p alife_game_app --features foundation-training --lib deterministic_nonrich_priming -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Deterministic non-rich prior contract failed' }

        if: ${{ !inputs.build_only }}
        run: |
          python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_run_continuous_care.py -v
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Continuous-session host contracts failed' }
      - name: Compile experimental CLI and full-state inspector
        run: |
          $residentBuildArgs = @('build','--locked','-p','alife_game_app','--features','foundation-training','--bin','train_n2048_care','--bin','export_native_training_handoff','--bin','inspect_archived_success')
          if ($env:BUILD_PROFILE -eq 'release') { $residentBuildArgs += '--release' }
          cargo @residentBuildArgs
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native compile failed' }
          $residentBinaryRoot = if ($env:BUILD_PROFILE -eq 'release') { 'target/release' } else { 'target/debug' }
          & (Join-Path $residentBinaryRoot 'train_n2048_care.exe') --resident-contract
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native capability query failed' }
      - name: Bind artifact to exact source and executable bytes
        id: bind
        run: |
          $residentRevision = git rev-parse HEAD
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $residentRevision -ne $env:EXPECTED_SOURCE) { throw 'Unexpected compiled source revision' }
          if (git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no) { throw 'Compiled source changed' }
          $residentTree = git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}'
          $residentOutputName = 'resident-experimental-{0}-{1}' -f $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID, $env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT
          $residentOutput = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP $residentOutputName)
          $residentHashes = [ordered]@{}
          $residentBinaryRoot = if ($env:BUILD_PROFILE -eq 'release') { 'target/release' } else { 'target/debug' }
          foreach ($residentName in @('train_n2048_care.exe','export_native_training_handoff.exe','inspect_archived_success.exe')) {
            $residentFile = Join-Path $residentBinaryRoot $residentName
            $residentHashes[$residentName] = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $residentFile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $residentFile -Destination $residentOutput.FullName
          }
          $residentContractJson = & (Join-Path $residentBinaryRoot 'train_n2048_care.exe') --resident-contract
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Built producer capability query failed' }
          $residentContract = $residentContractJson | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($residentContract.finite_continuous_feeding -ne $true -or $residentContract.temporary_budget_enforced_during_writes -ne $true -or $residentContract.bound_run_cleanup -ne $true) {
            throw 'Built producer lacks the finite-session/quota/cleanup contract'
          }
          $residentReceipt = [ordered]@{
            schema=1; kind='experimental-resident-build-v1'; source_revision=$residentRevision; source_tree=$residentTree
            executables=$residentHashes; rustc=(rustc --version); target='x86_64-pc-windows-msvc'
            features=@('foundation-training'); build_profile=$env:BUILD_PROFILE; gpu_training_executed=$false
            experimental=$true; production_qualified=$false
            resident_producer_contract=$residentContract
            workflow_run="https://github.com/$env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          }
          $residentReceiptJson = $residentReceipt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
          $residentReceiptJson | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $residentOutput.FullName 'build-receipt.json') -Encoding utf8
          Write-Output $residentReceiptJson
          "artifact_path=$($residentOutput.FullName)" | Out-File -LiteralPath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-resident-${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}-${{ env.EXPECTED_SOURCE }}
          path: ${{ steps.bind.outputs.artifact_path }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 2
